left.title: What I Do
left.body: Ship MVPs in weeks, not months. Full-stack, firmware, or both.

right.title: Building a startup?
right.body: I turn ideas into MVPs. From database to deploy, one engineer.

right.title: Updating your product?
right.body: Legacy code → modern stack. I've done 90% LCP improvements. Yours next?

right.title: Need firmware?
right.body: Teensy, ESP32, Arduino. Sensors to servos. Flight-tested at 3km altitude.

right.title: Edge fleet to manage?
right.body: Docker deploys and OTA updates for distributed devices, telemetry over Tailscale / Cloudflare. I cut on-site service visits by 60%.

right.title: Vision on the device?
right.body: Object detection on a Raspberry Pi 5 with no cloud: up to 78% less redundant inference, context switches in 300 ms.

right.title: Need a PCB, fast?
right.body: I build rekafab — describe a board, get a schematic, layout, checks and firmware you can send to a fab.
